method: At every delivered integer frame, evaluate FCurves and actual dependency-graph camera world matrix; compare to identical-timing polyline, then test actual camera position and previous-frame sweep against mesh. Walking modes additionally test body and ground; cuts never receive a cross-segment sweep.

room_coverage.label: North Upper Walk and Spiral Landing

limits: A room identifier includes terraces, stairs, pool and service inspection spaces; it is not a count of habitable rooms.
A camera covering a room is geometric inspection coverage, not proof of a satisfactory rendered view.
Explicit cuts do not establish connected walking. GUI navigation and tour exposure remain unverified.
